limitations: 1500 rpm, half load; exact torque, spark timing, air/fuel ratio and thermal conditions not specified in Fig7.2 caption.
Dimensions supplemented from same research-family publication; cannot establish identical build configuration from unavailable thesis CD-ROM.
577.8g is Fig7.4 piston assembly incl rod section A; published 2009 whole effective mass 0.64kg is a different definition and is not substituted.
Related Dyson engine has 1mm pin offset; present model is explicitly zero-offset.
Gas force digitization is converted to differential pressure, not an original absolute cylinder-pressure sensor trace.
Measured strain-gauge rod force has additional rod-section dynamics, friction and gravity; it is not identical to the ideal piston-side axial force.
Sparse plot readings cannot resolve peak timing or provide experimental combustion validation.
